title: NHK — 禅の心：日本文化の根底にあるもの (The Zen Mind)
description: NHK documentary exploring how Zen Buddhism (禅宗) has shaped Japanese aesthetics, design, and daily practice. Visits Kyoto and Kamakura temples, examines the tea ceremony's Zen roots, wabi-sabi aesthetics, zazen meditation practice, and how Zen's 'present-moment awareness' philosophy has influenced modern mindfulness worldwide.
